payload.reason: The evidence provides details on how clusters were extracted and their role in feature augmentation for sentiment classification tasks.

claims.text: Clusters were produced using out-of-domain embeddings trained on Wikipedia, which were found to improve performance in sentiment classification tasks.
The feature extraction process involved using cluster membership features alongside word embeddings, specifically trained using the skip-gram model.
Manual examination of words associated with clusters showed that they effectively grouped words with positive and negative meanings, aiding sentiment classification.
